up: Retrieve activity data for the human single-protein target CHEMBL3772 (Metabotropic glutamate receptor 1, tax_id = 9606, target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'). Filter for IC50 measurements (standard_type = 'IC50'), exact standard relation ('='), and non-null pChEMBL values (pchembl_value IS NOT NULL). Output columns: assay ChEMBL ID (assays.chembl_id), target type (target_dictionary.target_type), tax_id (target_dictionary.tax_id), canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), molecule ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), standard type (activities.standard_type), and pChEMBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Order by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to exactly 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3772' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
